segment.description: The TWRA-stocked trout water at Shelby Farms Park, Memphis (Shelby County). TWRA's live stocking table lists 'Shelby Farms' (Region 1, Shelby County) with Winter-type rainbow trout stockings on 1/13/2026 and 'TBD 12/2026'. The park's own fishing page identifies the stocked water as Jones Pond: 'Trout are stocked in Jones Pond every December and January.'
segment.boundaries: Jones Pond, Shelby Farms Park, Memphis, Shelby County, TN; TWRA Region 1 winter stocking program site (cold-window stockings only).

coldSource.notes: Park's fishing page describes 20+ warmwater fishing lakes/ponds (catfish, crappie, bream, largemouth bass) with no cold-water source mentioned for any lake. https://www.shelbyfarmspark.org/fishing

holdover.detail: No site-level holdover documentation found. Program-level context: TWRA's Trout Management Plan 2017-2027 states hatchery-supported streams and lakes 'are primarily warmwater habitats that cannot support trout year round.' The park restocks annually every December-January, consistent with a put-and-take cycle.

wildPopulation.detail: No wild trout record for this park lake. TWRA Trout Management Plan 2017-2027: 'Wild trout are generally limited to East Tennessee's mountain streams.'

overallSurvivalRead.oneLineWhy: The park says trout are stocked in Jones Pond every December and January (annual restart of a winter program), and TWRA's plan says warmwater hatchery-supported waters cannot support trout year round.

sourcesChecked: https://www.tn.gov/twra/news.html (miss: release list is JS-rendered; 12/31/2025 winter-program-continues release not retrievable at a verified URL)
